history.description: Initial version created based on the confirmed screen designs

purpose: This document explains the purpose of EMS's Depot Activity Acceptance Group details.
features: Acceptance Group Function allows the user to change the PR status from Prepared to supplied or Empty or full return status.
PR Status must be in "Prepared" status.

events.description: Opens the Acceptance Group screen in a new tab for the selected PR
events.triggered_when: User clicks the Menu icon near the desired PR Number and clicks Acceptance Group from the single function menu

events.description: Opens a pop up to upload a file for updating containers
Loads the containers and dates in the uploaded file into the data grid
events.triggered_when: User clicks Load after selecting a file

events.description: Saves the container details of the selected records
events.triggered_when: User clicks Submit after entering all mandatory fields
